Bambinata
Hmm... A mystery box... Do you wish Bambinata to open it with her eyes closed, Commandant?
Just how you usually unwrap a box is fine.
(Explain the mystery box)
Bambinata
Okay, Bambinata understood.
With care, she takes the gift and opens it gracefully on the table.
Bambinata
What's this...?
In confusion, she gazes at the folded light yellow plush item in her hand.
You quickly spot a button that matches the color of the object. As you reach out and press it, the once flattened thing immediately begins to swell and take shape.
Bambinata
Huh... Commandant...?
Fluttered, Bambinata holds it until it stops expanding, forming into a light yellow star.
So it's an inflatable headwear that was popular a while ago.
The advertisement for this product was still ubiquitous not long ago. Although the design may lack practicality, it does serve as a source of entertainment when people take photos while wearing it.
Bambinata
Headwear... L-like this?
Bambinata eagerly inserts her head into the yellow star without any hesitation. The five plush points of the star surround her eyes, making her appearance both endearing and amusing.
Bambinata
Eh... Did Bambinata misplace it? Commandant?!
You try to hold back your desire to laugh, but unfortunately, your efforts prove in vain. Noticing the curl of your lips, Bambinata becomes anxious and seeks your guidance.
Not at all. You look very cute in that.
Now, it almost feels like a waste if you don't capture this moment.
Before you even ask for Bambinata's permission, a smile spreads across her face as she catches sight of your raised terminal.
You respond to her with a smile and press the photo button—
Snap.
